ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution creating high-contrast features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions concentrated on lateral lobe tips; numerous circular white foci (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; linear white streaks prominent on the medial-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 48-52 degrees; lower vertex point is obscured by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge contains high-frequency jagged serrations (approx. 8-12 distinct peaks); left lobe trailing edge is smoother with low-amplitude undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a standard convex sweep to an acute tip; right lobe exhibits a convex sweep ending in an irregular, bulbous morphology at the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 12+ localized circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the black ventral surface, varying in diameter from 10 to 30 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear white pixel disruptions; at least three distinct parallel vertical-diagonal rake marks visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark brown cluster of macro-parasitic organisms attached to the right fluke tip; irregular depigmented scarring and jagged edge morphology on the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct stalked barnacle-like colony (Xenobalanus) attached to the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
